chosen.justification: No schema.org class directly represents a discovery event; 'Event' is the appropriate parent.

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: UserLikes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of expressing approval or liking for content. Also called user like, content like, approval. Examples: a user liking a photo on social media, giving a thumbs-up to a video, favoriting an item.

candidates.label: UserCheckins
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of checking into a location or event. Also called user check-in, location check-in, event attendance. Examples: a user checking into a restaurant, checking into a concert, marking attendance at a conference.

candidates.label: UserPlays
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of playing media content. Also called user play, media playback, content viewing. Examples: a user playing a video, listening to an audio track, starting a game.

candidates.label: CourseInstance
candidates.comment: A CourseInstance is a specific offering of an educational course, distinguished by its particular time, location, medium, or target student group. Also called course section, class session, course offering, specific class. Examples: "Fall 2023 Introduction to Python (Online)," "Spring 2024 Art History 101 (Campus A, Section B)," "Summer Intensive Yoga Teacher Training." Distinct from Course, which is the general description of the educational content.
